text:
maria_sales: Hey team — ConcertCo is evaluating Redwood to replace ApiStreamX. They want a POC showing parity for chat + embeddings, security signoff, and pricing delta. Can we assemble plan today?

alexa_se: Got it. Do we know which endpoints/features they rely on (streaming chat, function calls, tool hooks)? Any auth quirks?

maria_sales: They use streaming chat + batch embeddings. Auth is an `X-Api-Key` header. Also using a custom `role:system` prompt wrapper and rely on model stop sequences. Contact is Sam (sam@concert.co).

ben_engineer: We can build a compat shim for 1:1 endpoint mapping. Watch out for default `temperature` and `max_tokens` — ApiStreamX had temp=0.7 and `truncate_on` behavior that affects completions. We'll need prompt-preservation tests.

ben_engineer: Example mapping snippet:
```
POST /v1/chat -> POST /v1/responses
headers: { 'X-Api-Key' -> 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' }
preserve: role/system wrapper
```

michelle_security: They attached a security questionnaire (link: https://files.concert.co/security_questionnaire.pdf). Do they require VPC or on-prem? Any data residency? If yes, we escalate to Private deployment track.

jeff_infra: Also need latency SLOs. What tail latency do they expect for streaming? Any RPS/peak windows? That affects Dedicated sizing.

maria_sales: They expect <300ms for short-turn responses, bursty during business hours (~200 RPS, spikes to 700). They asked about enterprise pricing vs pay-as-you-go.

alexa_se: For parity validation: propose a small eval harness that replays 1k representative prompts from their logs, compare top-k token sequences and semantic similarity on embeddings. Canary traffic + A/B for 48h.

ben_engineer: Agree. We should include prompt-edge tests: stop-token handling, function/tool call payload shape, and multi-turn context length retention. Redwood Optimize can suggest quantization and batching profiles for their workload to control unit cost.

michelle_security: I'll draft answers to the security questionnaire. Need the SAM contact to sign an NDA if we are to get sample logs. Also verify their KMS reqs.

maria_sales: I'll request NDA + sample logs. Also they asked about fallbacks if a model variant returns unsafe output — need to document fallback policies.

devops_bot: POC checklist created: https://rdw.internal/poc-checklists/interop-bridge-2478901234 (added by deploy-bot) :white_check_mark:

jeff_infra: For Dedicated sizing estimate, give me expected tokens/sec and average seq length. If they want <300ms, we'll likely need reserved GPUs plus burst.

alexa_se: Action items: (1) ben = compat shim prototype + prompt-preserve tests (ETA 2 days); (2) michelle = security Q + NDA draft (ETA 1 day); (3) jeff = sizing delta & pricing tiers (ETA 1 day); (4) maria = request logs + confirm SSO/KMS. Sync tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar:

maria_sales: 10am PT works. Sam at ConcertCo is ok with NDA. Thanks everyone :heart:

ben_engineer: quick note — some ApiStreamX models append a trailing `\n` after code blocks; include normalization step in the harness to avoid false diffs.

alexa_se: I'll prepare an eval template and shared notebook for Sam to run locally if needed.

michelle_security: Also flag: their security team asked about data deletion timelines and audit logs — adding to questionnaire answers.

maria_sales: Great. I'll post NDA + sample logs link here once I have it. Thanks all. :rocket:
